initial:
Create a polished ORIGINAL static human character design sheet for a high-end 2D animated educational film, in the graphic character-design language of Kurzgesagt. Study the two supplied official reference images for their deliberately designed silhouettes, compact expressive faces, solid dark eyes, bright flat color shapes, flowing hair masses, and sparse meaningful detail. The attached reference scenes and characters must NOT be reproduced or pasted into the sheet: draw two new original people.

The deliverable is an exceptionally appealing, beautifully drawn, clean full-color character sheet, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536 by 1024 or higher. Plain warm ivory background. No text whatsoever, no branding, no labels, no borders, no palettes, no annotations, no props except one small cup. Careful organized spacing with complete uncropped silhouettes and a generous margin. Main left 56% of sheet: two LARGE full-body characters standing alongside one another. Right 44%: four large isolated head-and-shoulder expression studies in a 2x2 arrangement. Upper row is the woman, lower row is the man, maintaining exactly the same identities and costumes as the full-body figures. Do not make the expression studies tiny; the facial drawings must be readily judgeable.

Character one, Mira: a shorter young adult woman, compact rounded proportions about 4.5 heads tall, a broad soft cheek-and-jaw shape, rose/magenta skin with one restrained darker rose shadow plane, small solid deep-purple oval eyes WITHOUT white sclera or glints, expressive slightly asymmetric eyebrows, a small softly shaped nose, and a small mouth positioned comfortably within the cheeks, away from the outer face edge. Beautiful dark plum asymmetrical short wavy bob with a rounded tapered silhouette and two or three flowing locks that describe the skull, rather than a box or helmet. One subtle hair color plane follows the sweep; no sticker-like shine wedge. Warm mustard short relaxed HOODIE with natural shoulder slope, a curved hem and pale lining at its opening, plum wide cropped trousers and light cream rounded sneakers. No long coat, no pointed shirt collar, no buttons or zipper decoration. Natural relaxed three-quarter stance with a slight weight shift, a gentle curious expression, shoulders and hips coherently oriented with the head. One hand holds a cream cup close to the torso with a visible thumb and softly grouped fingers wrapping it naturally. Other hand rests loosely. Use filled tapered garment contours, intentional sleeve overlaps and a short naturally connected neck.

Character two, Sol: a slightly taller, broader, stockier adult man with a contrasting sturdy silhouette about 5 heads tall. Warm ochre/coral skin, broad softly squared face and full cheeks, short rounded nose, small dark solid eyes, slightly stronger brows, a small friendly relaxed mouth. Deep indigo short swept hair with a strong single flowing silhouette and varied large/small tufts, no repeated bubble scallops or bat-shaped highlight. Deep teal relaxed rolled-sleeve KNIT SWEATER, with round neckline, lavender-gray roomy trousers and muted coral rounded shoes. No coat, no shirt collar, no zipper. In a natural three-quarter stance facing slightly toward Mira, head, shoulders, chest and hips aligned as one body. One open conversational hand held near waist level: clear palm, visible thumb, gently curved grouped fingers with plausible anatomy, NOT a spiky star or a flat splayed fan. Other hand rests in trouser pocket. Broad comfortable shoulders taper into the garment; no rounded tube joint caps.

Expression studies on the right: Mira upper-left gently worried/uncertain in three-quarter view, upper-right warmly interested with a small restrained smile in a slightly different head angle. Sol lower-left attentive in three-quarter view, lower-right relaxed warm smile in a true profile view. Redraw actual cheek, jaw, eye, brow, and mouth relationships for each view and expression while retaining the same person. Mouths small and natural. No exaggerated toothy grin. The neck joins the shoulders naturally and does not appear like a separate block.

Art quality: exceptional professional character appeal and confident contour design. Consistent graphic 2D shapes, varied curve rhythms, purposeful asymmetry, big-medium-small shape hierarchy. A flat limited color palette with a few clean shadow planes, crisp vector-like edges and no outer black outlines. No 3D rendering, no photorealism, no anime, no glossy enormous eyes, no corporate stock-explainer noodly limbs, no texture or scenery to distract from the actual character drawing. The two characters should feel like a coherent cast, clearly different people in every silhouette, warm and appealing rather than generic, rigid or awkward.
profile_correction:
Edit this original character sheet with ONE localized correction only: the man's isolated bust in the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner must be a true 90-degree RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, with exactly ONE visible dark eye. Redraw that bust's face contour, forehead, small rounded nose, lips and chin as a clean appealing profile silhouette, and turn the neck and shoulders coherently into the same side view. Retain this exact person's warm orange/ochre skin, swept indigo hair, small smile and teal round-neck sweater. Keep the hair's identity and the compact friendly head proportions. The nose must remain short and rounded, not long or triangular. No far-side eye should be visible at all.

Preserve the two full-body characters on the left and the other three expression studies EXACTLY. Preserve the warm ivory background, overall 1536x1024 landscape layout, colors, polished 2D shape style, generous margins, and lack of text. Do not add objects, labels, frames, arrows, palettes or new figures. This is still a static concept sheet, not a scene.
